correctness.rationale: The all-edge transposition generator satisfies L0 eta_i=k-N eta_i and L0(eta_i eta_j)=(k-1)(eta_i+eta_j)-2(N-1)eta_i eta_j (i != j). Stationarity of these identities and deterministic full-state Poisson reset gives exact first and second moments. Subtracting products gives all three rational covariance expressions with denominator (N+r)^2(2N+r-2)>0. Their affine/quadratic numerator signs establish existence, exact uniqueness, and class boundaries, including k=1,2 and l=1,2. The stationary chain is irreducible on fixed k configurations. The package script independently checks 2766 covariances from finite unreduced Markov generators and three symbolic polynomial identities; finite checks corroborate rather than prove all N.

value.rationale: Positive covariance at a fixed particle count is a substantive boundary to negative-dependence intuition from ordinary exclusion dynamics. The theorem gives exact all-size and all-filling thresholds, identifies the minimal admissible occupancy/vacancy counts, and proves mixed-initial-occupation pairs never reverse. It is a complete finite-volume stationary correlation classification in an interacting transport model with collective resetting and yields exact simulation benchmarks; no arbitrary numerical slicing.
